name: app-transactions-table-dashboard-on-tilted-tablet
title: Full-size tilted tablet with transactions table, gradient summary cards and glass coins
whatItIs: A large tilted tablet on pale blue sky with a sidebar (Home, Tasks, Transactions selected, Payments...), three gradient cards for net change, money in and money out, a table with Google entries, status pills and method chips, and a black 'M' logo at the corner.
whatItMeans: Efficient and friendly; pastel gradients soften a finance table.
techniques: Tilt the device to fill the frame.
Highlight the active nav item in lilac.
Use blurred rainbow gradients for summary tiles.
Add a small logo in the corner.

vocabulary.definition: A tinted row marking the current page.
A small outlined pill naming a payment method.
A studio logo in a corner.
A tablet shown at a steep angle.
